lessons.raw_lesson: Safe or test PASS is unfinished unless it has a path into active agent life.
lessons.meaning: A school success must graduate into active memory, skill, or behavior; otherwise it is only an archive proof.
lessons.behavior_rule: After a school PASS, produce promote/reject/quarantine decision and never leave orphan lab proof.
lessons.proof_required: promotion manifest, active pointer/store, active retrieval, behavior delta proof

lessons.raw_lesson: Test mode should mean the same real process on a copy, not a toy mock.
lessons.meaning: Safe mode is a protected place for real semantics, not a fake process.
lessons.behavior_rule: Before RealApply, prefer twin/copy execution with same mutation semantics, rollback, and validators.
lessons.proof_required: copy/twin run report, same contract, same validators, rollback

lessons.raw_lesson: A living cell is useful only if it accepts, digests, stores meaning, changes behavior, proves it, and reports upward.
lessons.meaning: A Builder cell is not a file or function; it is a smallest growth unit with boundary, law, input, digestion, memory trace, behavior expression, validator, rollback, promotion, and return-to-parent.
lessons.behavior_rule: Do not call a cell mature until it changes future behavior and reports proof to parent.
lessons.proof_required: cell contract, digestion output, behavior-use proof, rollback, parent report

lessons.raw_lesson: Obligation belongs to school; freedom belongs to the observed life path after school.
lessons.meaning: Immature Builder grows by directive school. After proof, it enters bounded observed autonomy; freedom is loosened or tightened by behavior.
lessons.behavior_rule: If immature teach by obligation; if promoted let it act under observation; if behavior improves loosen one boundary; if behavior degrades return to school.
lessons.proof_required: school pass, life-path observation trace, maturity score, return-to-school gate

lessons.raw_lesson: The agent must not scan all atoms when memory grows huge.
lessons.meaning: Always-on memory must be a small law/profile/map/index pointer set; task memory must retrieve only top-k relevant items.
lessons.behavior_rule: Use law kernel, classify domain, choose shard/index, retrieve top-k, inject compact rules; never load bulk atom stores into every task.
lessons.proof_required: retrieval budget, no_full_scan flag, top_k count, store byte limit

lessons.raw_lesson: Seklitova/Strelnikova books are an architectural analogy source for unknown self-growth structures, not proof.
lessons.meaning: Use structural analogies such as matrix, hierarchy, law kernel, quality accumulation, and atom-to-organism growth only after project laws and before design candidates.
lessons.behavior_rule: When no software precedent exists, convert analogy into compact requirement, then validator, then proof.
lessons.proof_required: source ladder citation in strategy, extracted requirement, validator, proof report

molecules.compact_meaning: School/test success must graduate through promotion into active body, preferably after real semantics are proven on a copy.
Build living cells by analogy-informed requirements, but accept maturity only after behavior proof and parent report.
School is directive; life path is observed freedom; memory use is selective top-k, never full scan.
